question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Retired**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Active**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Retired"** refers to someone who has stopped working, usually after reaching a certain age, or has withdrawn from an active life. (सेवानिवृत्त)
 
 
• **Example:** After working for 40 years, he finally retired and decided to travel the world.
 
 
• **"Active"**, on the other hand, means someone who is energetic, engaged, or involved in physical or mental activities. It is the direct opposite of being retired or withdrawn. (सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being over 70, she remains active by participating in community events and yoga classes.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **"Retired"** is **"Active"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Active**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Idle** (निष्क्रिय): Refers to someone who is not working, not active, or doing nothing.
 
 
• **Example:** He spent the entire afternoon idle, just staring out of the window.
 
 
 
• **Resting** (आराम कर रहा): Refers to someone taking a break or relaxing.
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day of work, she is resting in the living room.
 
 
 
• **Inactive** (अक्रिय): Refers to someone or something not engaging in any activity or motion.
 
 
• **Example:** The volcano has been inactive for centuries.
 
 

3e:T968,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Falsehood**.
